goal: Upgrade map tiles from legacy MapQuest-like OSM to modern CartoDB Voyager with persistent multi-style switcher

steps.description: Implement modern map styles (CartoDB Voyager as default, Positron, Dark Matter, Satellite, OSM) and style switcher in static/app.js
Add styled map style selector control to map floating controls in static/index.html and static/style.css
Verify API contracts and test suite to ensure zero regressions
